sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Demonam is a light-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Defense (C), Agility (B).

sections.title: Is the Demonam Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (C), Agility (B). A dedicated light pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
